issues.observed: The publisher abstract names flowers and unripe fruit of Ruscus aculeatus (autumn). Leaves are not mentioned. The full text (BioOne) is subscriber-only and was not read, so 'leaves' is unconfirmed rather than shown to be wrong.
evidence: Del Vecchio et al. (2011), Herpetologica 67(3), Table 1, p. 240, full-text displayed on ResearchGate; publisher abstract at DOI 10.1655/HERPETOLOGICA-D-10-00064.1
issues.proposed_fix: Read Table 1 of the full text. If leaves are absent, change the part to flowers and unripe fruit; otherwise add the table locator.
issues.resolution: Del Vecchio et al. 2011 Table 1 lists Ruscus aculeatus plant parts as 'Fruits, seeds' (p. 240); abstract separately states flowers and unripe fruit in autumn. Leaves are not reported in either. Updated data/plant_feeding_evidence_links.json accordingly. No captive feeding safety inferred.
issues.ledger_status: data/feeding_record_verification_v1.json records this source as full_text_table_cited_not_extracted (2026-10-18): the observation above (2026-10-17, abstract only) is superseded by the Table 1 reading, but the record is not counted as full_text_confirmed until it is added to data/feeding_record_fulltext_extracts_v1.json with method and site locators.
